inlines.v: HEGI'RA, noun In chronology, an epoch among the Mohammedans, from which they compute time. The event which gave rise to it was the flight of Mohammed from Mecca; from which the magistrates, fearing his impostures might raise a sedition, expelled him, July 10, adjective D. 622, under the reign of the emperor Heraclius.
